description.en: Provides 2 free MCP tools - no authentication needed, no payment, ready to use out of the box: 1. ip2region supports geolocation queries for any IP address; 2. get_local_ip gets your local public IP. For non-MCP calls, use ifconfig.cc - also free.
description.zh-Hans: 可获取本地公网ip，并且支持任意ip地址归属地查询
